title:
Creates test data for {@Link FileExplorer} and utility functions
to teardown and setup the test data.
The file/directory structure the setup() method creates is the following:

/ (the default root)
  - Company/
    - Research/
      - AIML/
        - Products.txt
      - Robotics/
        - Products.txt
        - Teams/
    - Business/
      - Accounts/
        - Employees.csv
        - Clients.csv
      - Expenses/
        - OperatingCosts.txt
        - Wages.txt
name: FileExplorerTestData
